authority.title: A slower kind of morning
authority.body:
Take the long way to the coffee shop.

Notice the light in the windows, the small gardens, the city before it gets busy.

Bring a notebook. Leave a little room for something unexpected.

authority.title: Things worth making
authority.body:
A place to gather small, useful ideas.

• A reading corner by the window
• A map of favourite walking routes
• More time for unhurried conversations

authority.title: For the next little trip
authority.body:
Notebook, pencil, camera.
A good book and a light jacket.

Leave the schedule a little open.
